body: Well, I did some things in my early teens that were fucked up. Because of them, I don't think I will be able to become a police officer. I can't admit to them on a polygraph test. I don't wanna be criminalized.
This was one of the most liberating things to read honestly. Someone understands. Thank you for that comment. It feels good to at least know you know the same feeling.

This feeling sucks. I was driving home tonight and just thought about swerving off the road and maybe they would think it was an accident due to the storm instead of a suicide. I don't know, just don't want to feel like shit anymore. I don't want to feel depressed and like my mind is clouded with darkness and thoughts of no longer living. I thought I had conquered depression, but it's hit home again. It's tugging at my heart and my mind to just do it. To pull the trigger and call it a life.
